ANSWER (final record, ranks for round_20261029_093253_576 scoring_1).

RANK: BRad-RQ | position=1 | reason=It is the only proposal whose behaviour enters the item coordinate rather than the curvature/cost, and E6 shows the vanilla-family assignments are the ones that work (l1_br_euclid 0.06207, l1_only 0.06233, resample 0.06363) while every behaviour-in-geometry arm lost 0.007-0.016 (successor_entropy 0.05122, successor_geodesic_coarse 0.05500, tangent_successor_residual 0.05500); its fixed c=1 removes the saturation mode that E7 shows killed l1_br (T1/T2/T3/T4 NLL 0.00/0.00/0.00/9.03 with gold prefix alive 1.000/1.000/1.000/0.068), its reconstruction stays Euclidean on the tangent target, and its predecessor-side statistic is supported by E9 (0.9291 vs 0.8871 overlap, 0.5898 pairwise win, 1.65 nats over 7.5 cohorts, non-degenerate) plus the level-1 headroom in E11 (same_first_prefix_rate 0.0907 vs permuted null 0.067).

RANK: TSG-SID | position=2 | reason=E6's tangent_successor_residual arm (0.05500, gold prefix alive 0.643/0.180/0.090/0.073) is the closest existing test of transported successor tangents and it lost 0.007 against the 0.06207 Euclidean reference, so the mechanism is plausible-but-precedent-negative; it edges out BRANCHCURV only because it perturbs the STE gradient behind measured gates (kappa = d/(d+delta), soft bound r_l tanh) and leaves E8's first-level capacity untouched, whereas its cost claim (3-8%) is the more credible of the two heavy variants.

RANK: BRANCHCURV-MOEB-RQ | position=3 | reason=It is the composite of the two worst precedents in E6/E7: successor_entropy (the exact signal it uses, 0.05122) and l1_br (per-level curvature, 0.04671 with a degenerate T4 NLL of 9.03 and gold prefix 1.000/1.000/1.000/0.068), and its per-item curvature makes the shared codebook sit at different ball positions per item, i.e. it generalises the observed level-1 domination/collapse rather than avoiding it; its claim that removing the cap fixes l1_br does not address that collapse mode, and E5's clean entropy stratification (Spearman -0.973) confirms the signal is real, not that routing it into the residual chain helps.
